question: What did Samson finally tell Delilah was the secret of his strength?
options: If his head were shaved, his strength would leave him
If he drank wine, his strength would leave him
If he were tied with gold chains, he would be weak
If he touched a dead body, he would be weak
explanation: Samson told her no razor had ever been used on his head because he was a Nazirite. If his head were shaved, his strength would leave him.
